seoTitle: Sparkline Generator: Tiny Inline SVG Trend Charts
metaDescription: Paste numbers to get a small line, area or bar sparkline as copyable SVG sized for text or table cells. Free, no library.
intro: Creates a small trend chart as an inline SVG with an accessible name that states the start, end, lowest and highest values.
why:
Sparklines sit inside sentences and table cells to show the shape of a series. The SVG has no scripts and no axes, only the shape and optional markers for the last point, the minimum and the maximum.

The accessible name carries the key numbers, because a tiny drawing alone tells screen reader users nothing. Paste the SVG straight into HTML or an email-safe image pipeline; width and height are set in pixels.
howTo: Choose line, area or bars and set width and height.
Pick a colour and type a short name.

faq.q: Can I scale it with CSS?
faq.a: Yes, it has a viewBox, so set width and height in CSS.
Orange minimum, green maximum, last point in the line colour.
Many clients block inline SVG; render it to an image first.
